id.verification.camera.access.failure.te: It looks like we're unable to access your camera. Please verify that your webcam is connected and that you have allowed your browser to access it.
To enable camera access in Chrome:
Open Chrome.
Μεταβείτε στο Περισσότερα > Ρυθμίσεις.
For Mac: Command+,
For Windows: Alt+F, Alt+E, or F10 followed by the spacebar
Under the "Privacy and security" tab, select "Site Settings" and then "Camera."
Under "Blocked," find "edx.org" and select it.
In the "Permissions" section, update the camera permissions to "Allow."
To enable camera access in Firefox:
Open Firefox.
Enter "about:preferences" in the URL bar.
Select the "Privacy & Security" tab, and navigate to the "Permissions" section.
Next to "Camera," select the "Settings…" button.
In the search bar, enter "edx.org."
In the status column for "edx.org," select "Allow" from the drop down.
Επιλέξτε "Αποθήκευση αλλαγών".
To enable camera access in Internet Explorer:
Open the Flash Player Settings Manager by navigating to Windows Settings > Control Panel > Flash Player.
Select the "Camera and Mic" tab, and then select the "Camera and Microphone Settings by Site" button.
Choose "edx.org" from the list of websites and change the permissions by selecting "Allow" in the dropdown menu.
To enable camera access in Safari:
Open Safari.
Click on the Safari app menu, then select "Preferences." You can also use Command+, as a keyboard shortcut.
Select the "Websites" tab and then select "Camera."
Select "edx.org" and change the camera permissions to "Allow."

id.verification.camera.help.sight.answer: You may be able to complete the image capture procedure without assistance, but it may take a couple of submission attempts to get the camera positioning right. Optimal camera positioning varies with each computer, but generally, the best position for a photo of an ID card is 8-12 inches (20-30 centimeters) from the camera, with the ID card centered relative to the camera. If the photos you submit are rejected, try moving the computer or camera orientation to change the lighting angle. The most common reason for rejection is inability to read the text on the ID card.

You may be able to complete the image capture procedure without assistance, but it may take a couple of submission attempts to get the camera positioning right. Optimal camera positioning varies with each computer, but generally the best position for a headshot is approximately 12-18 inches (30-45 centimeters) from the camera, with your head centered relative to the computer screen. If the photos you submit are rejected, try moving the computer or camera orientation to change the lighting angle.
